title: Atlas .us Declaration
description: JSON Schema for Atlas .us declaration blocks. A .us document is prose carrying fenced JSON blocks; this schema validates the JSON blocks only.

id.description: Lowercase identifier (snake_case). Must match the filename stem for module blocks.

kind.description: Block kind. Exactly one module block per document.

can_approve.description: Structural safety gate. MUST be explicitly false. Absence is a refusal, never a default.

covenant.description: 16-char hex covenant hash (prefix of sha256 of foundation documents).

reports_to.description: Agent this seat reports to. Must resolve to another declared agent.

source.description: Citation of where this declaration's content originates.

permission.description: Permission map. Required for kind=agent. Keys are tool names; values are 'allow'/'deny' or glob maps.

body_v.description: Body format version. Required for kind=module.

ledger.description: Path to the chain ledger file. Required for kind=module.

rows.description: Non-empty list of module row names. Required for kind=module.

verbs.description: Non-empty list of verbs this module offers. Required for kind=module.
